verdict.rationale: Vue's official site links Pinia directly in its own ecosystem navigation (vue-docs-8). Multiple independent developers describe Vue as shipping an official, first-party store (Vuex) alongside its official router, so no third party is needed (vue-comm-9, vue-comm-13, vue-comm-12). One community critique of Vuex's effect on component modularity (vue-comm-19) is a design opinion and does not contradict the library's official status. Missing for 10: in-depth first-party documentation of Pinia's features and maintenance status (the evidence is only a nav link title), and explicit evidence that Pinia is the current official successor to Vuex and is co-maintained with the core framework.
